decisions.reason: A core piqué upholstery fabric with its own page, close to the established offer, likely meets aspiration in a growing industry, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
Flame-retardant jacquard serves the targeted contract and hospitality segment, where certified performance fabrics have long lifecycles and stable demand.

The wool-blend double-face fabric is only mentioned on the website and its blend conflicts somewhat with recyclability goals, but slack from a growing industry allows carrying it another year while results stay uncertain.
The wool bouclé leno fits the renewable-materials direction, though it overlaps with the dropped semi-transparent bouclé B, so it is kept with moderate risk pending clearer results.
Launched in 2024 with its own product page, the braided fabric is too new to judge against aspiration and has visible commitment, so it stays on the market.
